newsitem.title: USA: Bridgeville to merge with Northwest Savings.
newsitem.headline: Bridgeville to merge with Northwest Savings.

text.p: Bridgeville Savings Bank FSB and Northwest Savings Bank said on Tuesday the banks will merge at the close of business on Friday, February 21, 1997.
Under the terms of the agreement, each share of Bridgeville common stock will be converted into the right to receive $16 in cash, the companies said.
The companies said in a joint statement that shareholders and regulators approved the deal.
The deal will not change the staffs at either of the two banks, but there might be some work reassignments from the merger, the companies said.
